claims: Nationwide weather on March 17 is mostly cloudy with rain in places.
Fine dust concentrations in the capital region, South Chungcheong Province, and other mid-western regions on March 17 are at 'bad' to 'very bad' levels.
Daytime maximum temperatures on March 17 are around 10 to 18 degrees Celsius.
Fine dust levels in the capital region, South Chungcheong Province, and North Jeolla Province on March 17 are at the 'bad' level.
Fine dust emergency reduction measures are in effect in the capital region and South Chungcheong Province until 9 PM on March 17.
Morning minimum temperatures on March 17 are 1 to 10 degrees Celsius.
Daytime maximum temperatures on March 17 are 9 to 14 degrees Celsius, rising to 18 degrees Celsius in some regions.
The diurnal temperature range on March 17 is around 15 degrees Celsius.
5 to 20 mm of spring rain is expected centered on inland regions on March 17.
Strong winds are expected centered on Jeju Island and coastal regions on March 17.
Rain is expected nationwide tomorrow after March 17.
Mostly clear and mild weather is expected for the rest of the week after the rain tomorrow.
